title: The BEST Resume Format to Have
description:
Your resume is your lifeline, and you need to treat it as such. Your resume should be a perfect representation of you, from the contents, to the design. On this episode of the Teal Podcast, we the BEST resume format to have that will help you pass through the Applicant Tracking System (ATS), and get you a job when it's reviewed by a real-life person.
